claims.text: ACGS-2 uses a 26-service microservices architecture to enforce constitutional principles across distributed AI systems.
The ACGS-2 system achieved complete compliance across 847 constitutional test cases.
The ACGS-2 system sustained production loads exceeding 1,250 requests per second.
The ACGS-2 system maintained 99.99% uptime during chaos engineering experiments.
The ACGS-2 system achieves a P99 latency of 3.2 milliseconds for end-to-end request processing.
ACGS-2 incorporates a cryptographically-verified constitutional hash mechanism to ensure policy consistency across distributed services.

evidence.description: This comprehensive research introduces a novel 26-service microservices architecture specifically designed to enforce constitutional principles across distributed AI systems.
Through rigorous empirical validation, the system achieved complete compliance across 847 constitutional test cases.
Sustaining production loads exceeding 1,250 requests per second with sub-millisecond latency response times.
The system maintained 99.99% uptime during comprehensive chaos engineering experiments while processing sustained production workloads.
Performance benchmarking confirmed that constitutional governance overhead remains minimal, with P99 latency measurements of 3.2 milliseconds for end-to-end request processing.
The system implements a cryptographically-verified constitutional hash mechanism that ensures policy consistency across all distributed services.

methodologies.name: ACGS-2 Microservices Governance Architecture
methodologies.description: A 26-service microservices architecture combining cryptographically-verified constitutional hashing, formal verification, and AI-assisted policy synthesis for constitutional AI governance.
conditions: Sustained production loads exceeding 1,250 requests per second

limitations.text: Authentic democratic governance requires addressing sociotechnical challenges beyond technical infrastructure alone.
Fundamental challenges and a lack of practical implementation blueprints have limited the adoption of constitutional AI in enterprise environments.

future_work.text: Developing methodologies for authentic democratic constitution creation.
Addressing the complex sociotechnical challenges of implementing legitimate democratic governance processes within technical systems.
